name: AppGrid
tagline: Keeps Finder's Applications windows laid out as a 6-column, iPhone-style icon grid.
description: AppGrid is an invisible helper that keeps Finder's Applications windows laid out like an iPhone home screen: a 6-column grid where an icon dropped on a slot takes it and the others shift. It steps aside as soon as you sort the window another way. No interface, no settings, nothing stored.
caskExtra:
# AppGrid is a background helper (no window, no Dock icon): run it at login through a launch agent.
  postflight do
    agent = File.expand_path("~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.saasempiree.appgrid.plist")
    FileUtils.mkdir_p File.dirname(agent)
    File.write agent, <<~PLIST
      <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
      <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
      <plist version="1.0">
      <dict>
        <key>Label</key><string>com.saasempiree.appgrid</string>
        <key>ProgramArguments</key>
        <array><string>#{appdir}/AppGrid.app/Contents/MacOS/AppGrid</string></array>
        <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
        <key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
        <key>ProcessType</key><string>Interactive</string>
      </dict>
      </plist>
    PLIST
    system_command "/bin/launchctl", args: ["bootout", "gui/#{Process.uid}/com.saasempiree.appgrid"], must_succeed: false
    system_command "/bin/launchctl", args: ["bootstrap", "gui/#{Process.uid}", agent]
  end

  uninstall launchctl: "com.saasempiree.appgrid",
            quit:      "com.saasempiree.appgrid"
caveats:
AppGrid runs in the background (launch agent com.saasempiree.appgrid): it has no window.
On first use, allow it to control Finder (Automation) when macOS asks.
